free_tier.stated: 250 MB per package. No documented total-storage quota and no documented cap on package count per account; organizations are free. Over 500k packages / petabytes-scale gallery in practice.

egress.terms: Free and unmetered, Cloudflare-fronted, CORS-open. Probe: api.nuget.org v3-flatcontainer .nupkg GET -> 200, Server: cloudflare, Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *, Cache-Control: max-age=86400.

tooling: Push via PUT/POST to the v2 endpoint (nuget.exe / dotnet nuget push); pull via the v3 flat-container URL pattern api.nuget.org/v3-flatcontainer/{id}/{version}/{id}.{version}.nupkg. First-class clients, anonymous read.
chaining: UNBOUNDED in principle: unlimited packages x 250 MB. 10 TiB = ~44,000 packages. Rate limits are the binding constraint (HTTP 429 with Retry-After). Package IDs are globally unique per version and cannot be reused, so name-sharding has to be planned up front.
limits_note: 250 MB per package (hard 413). API rate limited (429 + Retry-After). Deleting a package is strongly discouraged and effectively unsupported ('In general, we do not support deleting a package published to NuGet.org'); unlisting is the normal path. Signed packages are immutable including the nuspec.
